_note: Recipe A anchor plus a VICReg statistics auxiliary (kind=vicreg, weight 0.1): a variance term holding per-dimension spread above a floor and a covariance term pushing off-diagonal covariance to zero, as an anti-collapse guard. Only the statistics half of VICReg is used; the invariance term is supplied by the existing masked-latent loss, so this is not a reproduction of the paper.
